title: Lineform
summary: An immersive 3D music visualizer: pick a track in the sidebar and the canvas reacts to the audio in real time.
summary_zh: 沉浸式 3D 音乐可视化站点：在侧边栏选一首歌，画布随音频实时变化。
summary_en: An immersive 3D music visualizer: pick a track in the sidebar and the canvas reacts to the audio in real time.

title: RAG
summary: A document Q&A and knowledge management app built on retrieval-augmented generation: upload PDF or Markdown, ask in natural language, and get streamed answers with citations.
summary_zh: 基于检索增强生成（RAG）的文档问答与知识管理应用：上传 PDF / Markdown，用自然语言提问，AI 基于检索片段流式作答并附来源引用。
summary_en: A document Q&A and knowledge management app built on retrieval-augmented generation: upload PDF or Markdown, ask in natural language, and get streamed answers with citations.

title: pi-dsh-pet
summary: A desktop pet for the pi coding agent: one command installs it, and a transparent animated fish floats on screen reacting to what the agent is doing — thinking, writing code, or idle.
summary_zh: 给 pi 编程助手的桌面宠物：一行命令装好，一只透明的动画大肥鱼浮在屏幕上，随 agent 状态（思考 / 写代码 / 空闲）切换动作。
summary_en: A desktop pet for the pi coding agent: one command installs it, and a transparent animated fish floats on screen reacting to what the agent is doing — thinking, writing code, or idle.

title: SOM_WHY's Site
summary: A bilingual personal site for photography, music and writing — rebuilt around an offline-first asset pipeline so it loads fast on a bad connection.
summary_zh: 一个承载摄影、音乐与写作的双语个人站点，围绕「离线优先」的资源管线重建，弱网下也能快速打开。
summary_en: A bilingual personal site for photography, music and writing — rebuilt around an offline-first asset pipeline so it loads fast on a bad connection.

title: clipGIF
summary: Turn video segments into GIFs with a visual timeline. Self-hosted, FastAPI + yt-dlp + ffmpeg, pluggable for more platforms.
summary_zh: 把视频片段转成 GIF，带可视化时间轴。本地自部署，FastAPI + yt-dlp + ffmpeg，可扩展支持更多平台。
summary_en: Turn video segments into GIFs with a visual timeline. Self-hosted, FastAPI + yt-dlp + ffmpeg, pluggable for more platforms.

title: react-masonry-layout
summary: A flexible masonry layout component for React, with built-in image loading states and layouts that adapt to the container rather than the viewport.
summary_zh: 一个灵活的 React 瀑布流布局组件：内置图片加载与错误处理，布局随容器尺寸自适应。
summary_en: A flexible masonry layout component for React, with built-in image loading states and layouts that adapt to the container rather than the viewport.
